text: FBA is an advanced technique that can estimate white matter fiber-specific measures from dMRI data for group analysis [ 30 ]. In FBA, fixels can be derived from fiber orientation distributions (FODs) of each voxel as typically computed from constrained spherical deconvolution [ 31 , 32 ]. Each fixel represents an element of the fixel grid that contains information on specific fiber orientation within an individual voxel [ 30 ]. The fixel-wise parameters include microstructural fiber density and macrostructural fiber-bundle morphology; they can reflect direct features of white matter fiber alterations such as axonal loss or atrophy, respectively [ 33 ]. In addition, FBA utilized a population template generated based on the study cohort, rather than transforming imaging data to an MNI template in common voxel-based approaches; such a study-specific template can be more representative of the study population [ 26 ].
source_label: White matter alterations and their associations with biomarkers and behavior in subjective cognitive decline individuals: a fixel-based analysis
